name: Girlfriends
overview: Scripture emphasizes the sanctity of marriage and the importance of loving relationships grounded in God’s design. Jesus teaches that marriage is a sacred covenant not to be broken except in cases of fornication, warning against adultery (Matthew 19:9; Hebrews 13:4). True love begins with loving God wholeheartedly (Matthew 22:37) and extends to treating others with brotherly kindness and honor (Romans 12:10). Husbands are called to love their wives sacrificially, reflecting Christ’s love for the church (Ephesians 5:25), setting a pattern for godly relationships including those involving boyfriends and girlfriends.
